nodes.label: Zero-to-Hero Study Handbook, legacy v1 (PDF, Streamlit-only)
Event-driven UI with Streamlit reruns
nodes.rationale: Streamlit reruns the whole script on interaction; st.session_state, st.fragment(run_every=...), and callbacks are used to keep state consistent while rendering live updates without a client-side framework.

nodes.label: Background worker pattern (daemon threads + Job registry)
nodes.rationale: Long-running generation runs in daemon threads via a process-global Job registry (src/jobs.py) so the Streamlit UI thread stays responsive during streaming, OCR, or web search.

nodes.label: Functional module style with typed data carriers
nodes.rationale: Most logic is organized as module-level functions with small dataclasses for structured data (ModelInfo, ApiModel, SelectedModel, Attachment, Job) rather than classes/services, keeping the codebase flat and easy to trace.
